native-collect.purpose: elite-v2 elite operator data: the first 8 elite-v2 portfolio plans of every elite stage and the first 1 of every Heroic/Iron challenge, for the elite operator network (layout v4), on train seeds 1131-1135, profile [3, 1.2, 13]; DAgger beta 0.0 (1.0: the plan executor plays and labels every decision; 0: the network plays, the executor labels); with the human-timing host features ['timed_clicks'] and 9-tick trap clicks

native-eval.purpose: elite-v3b replay with capture (development evidence, train seeds 1201-1204 only): the 56 S1b steady base games replayed by the steady brain with the screen recorded at every consult (towers, enemies, heroes, flag preview, spell buttons) and a memory ledger (lives lost per path, hero deaths), so the fair re-test's rich briefings describe exactly the moments whose fork outcomes are already measured; must reproduce S1b exactly (trace hashes, outcomes, 992/992 old prompt hashes)

native-campaign.purpose: option A: all 26 levels from a new save on Normal; after level 12, main levels won with fewer than 3 stars are replayed for stars; then the Heroic/Iron challenges of the 3-star main levels (each win adds a star to the upgrade budget) before the elite stages; a main level lost with every plan is retried after a stuck player's detour (replays of the earlier levels for stars and their open challenges) if the detour raised the star total: the fixed rule brain (ablation of the 8B strategy brain) picks each attempt's plan and star allocation (all 13 heroes from level 12 on); the main-campaign operator network (levels 1-12, action scope v2) and the elite operator network (elite stages and challenges, v3) execute every decision; up to 10 attempts per level with untried plans; rehearsal on evaluation seeds; human-timing host features ['timed_clicks']; 9-tick trap clicks
